description: Defines the MPSGuardImpl class and OptionalMPSGuard struct for managing MPS device guards and events in PyTorch's Metal Performance Shaders (MPS) backend.

classes.name: MPSGuardImpl
classes.description: Implements device guard interface for MPS devices, managing device and stream operations, and event handling.

classes.name: OptionalMPSGuard
classes.description: A wrapper for managing optional MPS device guards.

methods.name: createEvent
methods.description: Creates an MPS event with specified flag.

methods.name: record
methods.description: Records an event on a stream.

methods.name: block
methods.description: Blocks until an event is completed.

methods.name: queryEvent
methods.description: Queries the status of an event.

methods.name: synchronizeEvent
methods.description: Synchronizes the CPU with an event.

methods.name: elapsedTime
methods.description: Calculates elapsed time between two events.
